audit.name: v0.1.0 pre-release licensing audit — internal documentation licensing sweep
audit.baseline_commit_subject: audit: scope the MIT core, enforce the proprietary boundary, verify v0.1.0 packaging
audit.disclaimer: Research evidence only. This file records which internal documentation statements were found to be stale and what was done about them. It is not a licence grant, not legal advice, not a clearance, and not an authorisation to publish. The licence grant itself is LICENSE scoped by LICENSE_SCOPE.md; the current position, the open legal items and the NO-GO recommendation are in RELEASE_LICENSE_AUDIT.md.
